findings.exact_year: Cover removal involves front pan screws and loosening first six per side; Fig34 marks sealer at two front-cover/block seams and25 screws. This does not change installed25 count.
findings.compatibility: Fel-Pro VIN Y catalog explicitly pairs TCS45829/45830 with OS34601R. TCS45830 adds repair sleeve; no separate INS asset returned.
findings.one_piece: OS34601R attached I-1484 identifies one-piece molded rubber gasket. Noncoplanar rails/end architecture uses small RTV at four block-side corners.
findings.timing_cover_repair: I-223 attached to TCS45829 specifies retaining old pan seal during cover removal, cutting exposed front section flush, replacing front end seal on cover, trimming main gasket to castings as necessary, and a1/8 inch(3.175mm) silicone bead at pan/block intersections.
findings.five_hole_strip: Manufacturer instructions establish a replacement oil-pan front end seal in this repair. The five-hole photographed strip is consistent with that role, but sheet has no exact piece callout or matching five-hole outline; exact identification remains inferred. Never stack it over intact one-piece gasket.
findings.procedure_scope: A cover-only service repair with cut/replaced front seal differs from a full pan-gasket installation. For the intact OS34601R reconstruction, keep a continuous gasket and avoid adding a redundant strip.
findings.geometry_limit: Source instructions authorize no bridging of model gaps with sealant;1/8 inch is bead application size, not permissible joint gap.
